svg.title: Tasks / Where Agents, HTTP, and Git Are Contained
svg.desc: Autonomous harnesses act only through the installed CLI, HTTP stays on the loopback interface, and the merge driver runs inside Git with no configured store.. Solid colored outlines mark exact authored boundary members; dotted outlines mark collapsed elements that contain members. Neither is an inferred trust envelope.
